facts.fact: UNICEF's Representative says the Sistema Informatizado del Registro Civil (SIREC) was put into service in December 2018 through the Ministry of Justice, with the support of UNICEF and the European Union and the collaboration of CNIAPGE.

UNICEF's Representative says that, in modernising the Central Registry Centre under SIREC, 192,000 birth records covering 1980 to 2019 were converted to digital form and 20,000 new records were digitised; deaths are not mentioned (stated in a speech of 16 June 2021).

note: The speech does not say whether the 20,000 new records are births entered digitally at registration or paper acts keyed afterwards, and names no office other than the Central Registry Centre; it also gives 46 per cent of children as having no record of birth registration.
